deviceSetup.subtitle: These settings let Samona show new job requests even when the app is closed or the screen is off. Review each one below.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Job alerts arrive as notifications. On Android 14+, also allow the full-screen toggle so a request covers whatever you're doing.

fullScreen.title: Show alerts over other apps
fullScreen.description: A new job request should appear on top of other apps even while the app is closed. Android 14+ requires the full-screen permission to be switched on.

overlay.title: Show over other apps
overlay.description: The job-alert overlay draws Accept/Decline over any app while Samona is closed, and a floating Samona icon stays handy while you're online and working in other apps (it hides while the app is open). Grant "Appear on top" under Display over other apps so both can show.

battery.title: Battery — unrestricted
battery.description: Battery optimisation can stop the alert from ever arriving. Set Samona Pro to "Unrestricted" under Battery.

backgroundData.title: Background data
backgroundData.description: With background data restricted, a phone left untouched may never receive a job alert until you open the app again.

oemGuides.miui: MiUI: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Samona Pro → Autostart → On. Also Settings → Battery → Background app limits → No restrictions, and remove Samona Pro from any "battery saver" list.
oemGuides.samsung: One UI: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → Add Samona Pro. Also remove it from "Sleeping apps" and "Deep sleeping apps".
oemGuides.oneplus: OxygenOS: Settings → Battery → Battery optimization → Samona Pro → Don't optimize. Under Apps → Samona Pro → Battery usage, enable "Run in background".
oemGuides.coloros: ColorOS/OriginOS: Settings → Apps → Samona Pro → Battery → Allow background activity. If a "Autostart" list exists, enable it there too.
oemGuides.nearStock: Near-stock Android: the four checks above are all that matters. If alerts still stop while the app is closed, check the OEM battery app for a "sleeping apps" list.
oemGuides.generic: Every OEM tweaks this differently. Ensure Samona Pro is not inside a "sleeping apps", "deep sleep" or autostart restriction list under Battery in your phone settings.

deviceSetup.outOfSleepTitle: Keep Samona Pro out of sleep
deviceSetup.outOfSleepMessage: Some phones put unused apps to sleep, which stops job alerts. We can't check or change this from the app — set it once in your phone settings.

goingOnline.q: How do I go online to get job requests?
goingOnline.a: Tap the big ON button on the home tab and stay within your service area. Only nearby requested jobs that match your skills are shown to you.

exactLocation.q: Will customers see me at my exact location?
exactLocation.a: No. Customers see your approximate area and distance, not your precise location. Your exact location is only used for matching and navigation.

acceptDecline.q: How do I accept or decline a job?
acceptDecline.a: When a request arrives, open it and choose Accept or Decline. Accepting a job locks it to you and starts the journey to the customer.

decline.q: What happens if I decline a job?
decline.a: Declining does not hurt your rating. The request is passed to other nearby professionals who offer that service.

whenPaid.a: Your earnings for completed jobs are shown in the Earnings tab and payouts are transferred to your bank account every Monday.

breakdown.q: Where can I see my earnings breakdown?
breakdown.a: Open the Earnings tab to see completed jobs, job earnings, tips and the SAMONA fee for each payout cycle.

customer.q: What if a customer cancels a job?
customer.a: If a customer cancels a job you are committed to, you are notified right away and it moves to your cancelled list for acknowledgement.

afterAccept.q: Can I cancel after accepting a job?
afterAccept.a: Yes, but try to avoid it — cancelling after acceptance is disruptive for the customer. Repeated cancellations may affect which jobs are offered to you.

missing.q: Why did I not receive a job alert?
missing.a: Alerts depend on notification and overlay permissions. Visit Job alert setup in your Profile and make sure your device is allowed to run in the background.

toggle.q: How do I turn job alerts on or off?
toggle.a: Use the Job alert setup screen in your Profile. Enabling it lets notifications show even when the app is closed; disabling it stops new alert popups.

profile.a: During onboarding you complete identity, face and document verification together with your skills and service area. Your profile shows a verification badge once this is approved.
